description_full:
Info magang dari PT Multi Kontrol Nusantara

PT Multi Kontrol Nusantara is still looking for a motivated and detail-oriented intern to join our team!

If you're interested in project monitoring, budget tracking, cost analysis, and project management, this is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

What You'll Do:
1. Monitor project progress and timelines.
2. Assist in tracking project budgets and expenses (Budget vs. Actual).
3. Analyze cost variances and budget discrepancies.
4. Monitor project documentation.
5. Assist in project closing, cost reconciliation, and final reporting.

Requirements:
1. Bachelor's degree of Accounting, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or related majors.
2. Basic understanding of project management and cost control.
3. Proficient in Microsoft Excel, especially data processing and reporting.
4. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and numerical skills.
5. Good communication, coordination, and documentation skills.
6. Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team.

📍 Placement: Head Office, Jakarta
📩 Interested? Apply now through https://bit.ly/MKNHiring_Internship and be part of our team!
